full_text: THE SECOND LETTER. The follomng is the text of Gandhiji’s second letter to Lord Irwin drafted on the eve of his arrest: Dear Friend, 1 must Commence the March God willing, it is my intention to set out for Dharsana and reach there with my companions •, —and demand possession of the Salt Works. The public have been told that Dharsana is private property. This is mere camouflage. It is effective- ly under Government control as the Viceroy’s house. Not a pinch of salt can be removed without the previous sanction of the authorities. It is possible for you to prevent this raid, as it has been playfully and mischievously called in three ways;— by removing the salt tax; by arresting me and my party unless the country can as I hope it will, replace every one taken away; by sheer gondaism unless every head broken is replaced as I hope it will.
